'''Duncan McEwen''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], Gold 109 from Maumee, Oh. The slot was marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="sm-fan" />

He started playing after a friend got a two-player [[Premiere]] set for Christmas 1996, and planned to extend his Toledo email list to Ann Arbor.<ref name="decsq-prof" />
